title: Phishing suppression rate
summary: Share of inbound phishing_triage runs that terminate via the suppression branch (known-benign sender or already-seen fingerprint inside the suppression window) rather than reaching intent classification. Acts as a false-positive proxy: a creeping suppression rate indicates the reporting funnel is being trained to filter out real reports, while a collapsing rate indicates the suppression catalog is stale. Watched as a band, not a single direction.

target.rationale: Above 0.6 indicates suppression is eating reports the analyst queue should be seeing.

measurement.formula: count(playbook runs ending at the suppression close step) / count(playbook runs ending at any terminal step) over window.

inputs.name: suppressed
inputs.description: count of runs that closed via the suppress-and-close action

inputs.name: total_runs
inputs.description: count of all runs reaching the end step (any branch)
